title: design-migrate: refuse or flag a round-number collision with an existing claude-design/rounds/ when design.json is present
reason: With design.json present, legacy rounds merge beside an already-started claude-design round with no numbering check (two 01- rounds in the vocky probe); the no-design.json path refuses with a remedy
trigger: The next edit to design-migrate, or the first repo found with a design.json on a legacy root
